text.en:
The Commission on Population is hereby transferred to the
Office of the President and then attached to the Department of Health.
POMA Hologram * 18818

2

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 24 day of March
Lord, two thousand and three.
, in the year of our
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
